# t_funcs.square { #clerq.t_funcs.square }

```python
t_funcs.square(index)
```

Return a square (top-hat) pulse time function.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                            |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``on_{index}``, ``off_{index}`` and    |
|        | TFunc  | either ``ampl_{index}`` or ``n_pi_{index}`` from args. Returns         |
|        | TFunc  | ``ampl`` between ``on`` and ``off``, zero outside. Raises ``KeyError`` |
|        | TFunc  | if both or neither amplitude parameters are present, and               |
|        | TFunc  | ``ValueError`` if ``n_pi`` is used with ``off <= on``.                 |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

The amplitude can be set directly via ``ampl_{index}`` or indirectly
via ``n_pi_{index}`` (desired pulse area in multiples of π).
